name: Yosemite National Park
description: Yosemite National Park sprawls across 1,187 square miles of California's Sierra Nevada, and nearly all of it is wilderness. Glaciers carved its granite into sheer cliffs, domes and the deep, U-shaped Yosemite Valley, where waterfalls pour from hanging valleys above. Giant sequoia groves, meadows and alpine lakes add to a landscape that helped inspire America's national park idea.
